y-m-27-03.title: Kugadzira nhamba dzakaenzana dzine madhijiti maviri nemakadhi mashanu
y-m-27-03.topic: Huwandu hwezviitiko: kugadzira nhamba dzine mamiriro (0 haigone kuva pa tens place, kadhi rimwechete harigone kushandiswa kaviri)
y-m-27-03.goal: Gadzira iwe pachako nhamba dzinoenderana nemamiriro (0 haigone kuva pa tens place, kadhi rimwe nerimwe rinoshandiswa kamwe chete), uye uwane nekutsanangura kwanowanzo kukanganisa maitiro ekuverenga pasi pemamiriro iwayo.
y-m-27-03.material: Pane makadhi 5 akanyorwa 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, rimwe nerimwe. Sarudza makadhi 2 akasiyana kubva pazvo uye uaise nenzira yakarongeka kuti ugadzire integer ye digit maviri (kadhi rakaiswa rekutanga ndiro tens place uye kadhi rakaiswa shure ndiro ones place). 0 haigoni kuva pa tens place (muenzaniso: 03 haisi integer ye digit maviri). Kadhi rimwe chete rinogona kushandiswa kamwe chete (muenzaniso: 22 haigoni kugadzirwa).
y-m-27-03.prereq.0: Tens place ne ones place ye integer ye digit maviri
y-m-27-03.prereq.1: Ruzivo rwekuverenga huwandu hwenzira kana sarudzo dzakawanda dzichitevedzana
y-m-27-03.s.s1.prompt: Ma integer ye digit maviri mangani zvose anogona kugadzirwa nemakadhi aya?
y-m-27-03.s.s1.hint.0: Kutanga nyora makadhi ose anogona kuva pa tens place.
y-m-27-03.s.s1.hint.1: Mushure mekusarudza kadhi rimwe re tens place, verenga kuti makadhi mangani asara anogona kushandiswa ku ones place.
y-m-27-03.s.s1.r.a: Uku kuverenga kunoverenga kadhi rekutanga senzira 5 pamakadhi 5. Funga kuti wakaverengawo nyaya apo 0 yakaiswa pa tens place here.
y-m-27-03.s.s1.r.b: Uku kuverenga kwakatarisa kuti pane nzira dzingani kune tens place ne ones place imwe neimwe, uye kuti dzinokanganisana here.
y-m-27-03.s.s1.r.c: Wakaverengawo nyaya dzekushandisa kadhi rimwe chete kaviri. Tarisa kuti unogona kugadzira 22 kana 44 here.
y-m-27-03.s.s1.r.d: Zvinoita sekuti wakaverenga sarudzo dzishoma pa ones place. Mushure mekusarudza tens place, verenga kuti makadhi mangani asara.
y-m-27-03.s.s1.explain: Pa tens place, makadhi 4, 1, 2, 3, 4, anogona kuuya, kusiya 0. Pa ones place, makadhi mamwe 4 (anosanganisira 0), kusiya kadhi rakashandiswa mu tens place, anogona kuuya, saka 4×4=16.
y-m-27-03.s.s2.prompt: Gadzira ma integer ye digit maviri ari even 4 akasiyana uchichengeta mamiriro ari pamusoro. (Nhamba n yawakagadzira)
y-m-27-03.s.s2.hint.0: Kutanga sarudza kuti kadhi rinofanira kuva pa ones place rinoita sei kuti nhamba ive even.
y-m-27-03.s.s2.hint.1: Mushure mekusarudza kadhi re ones place, tarisa nekudzima rimwe rimwe kuti makadhi api anogona kushandiswa pa tens place.
y-m-27-03.s.s2.var.n: Nhamba ye digit maviri iri even yawakagadzira
y-m-27-03.s.s2.fail.c1: Makadhi ari 0 kusvika ku4 chete, saka inofanira kuva integer kubva ku10 kusvika ku44.
y-m-27-03.s.s2.fail.c2: Kadhi re tens place haigoni kuva 0 uye rinofanira kusarudzwa kubva ku0 kusvika ku4 chete.
y-m-27-03.s.s2.fail.c3: Ones place inofanirawo kuva imwe ye0 kusvika ku4.
y-m-27-03.s.s2.fail.c4: Haugoni kushandisa kadhi rimwe chete kaviri pa tens place ne ones place.
y-m-27-03.s.s2.fail.c5: Haisi even. Kuti ive even, ones place inofanira kuva digit ipi?
y-m-27-03.s.s2.explain: Kana ones place iri 0, tens place ndi1, 2, 3, 4 (nhamba 4); kana ones place iri 2, tens place ndi1, 3, 4 (nhamba 3); kana ones place iri 4, tens place ndi1, 2, 3 (nhamba 3); saka nhamba ari even ndi10 zvose: 10, 12, 14, 20, 24, 30, 32, 34, 40, 42.
y-m-27-03.s.s3.prompt: Seojin akaverenga, "Nhamba dzeven ndi nzira 4 dze tens place × nzira 3 dze ones place (0, 2, 4) = 12." Chikonzero chinokodzera zvakanyanya chekuti kuverenga uku kusina kururama chii?
y-m-27-03.s.s3.hint.0: Nyora zvose 12 uye uzvienzanise ne10 dzawakatarisa mu s2.
y-m-27-03.s.s3.hint.1: Kana kadhi re ones place riri 2, nyora makadhi anogona kushandiswa pa tens place.
y-m-27-03.s.s3.o.a: Inyaya apo unofanira kuwedzera, kwete kuwedzera nekuwedzera
y-m-27-03.s.s3.r.a: Inyaya apo unosarudza tens place wobva wasarudza ones place nenzira inotevedzana, saka nzira yekuwedzera yakarurama. Tarisa kuti nhamba dzipi dzakasanganiswa mukukosha kwakawedzerwa.
y-m-27-03.s.s3.o.b: Haina kuverenga nyaya apo 0 yakaiswa pa tens place
y-m-27-03.s.s3.r.b: Nzira 4 dze tens place dzakatoverenga 1 kusvika ku4 chete. Nyora iwe pachako nhamba dziri mu12 uye uidzitarise.
y-m-27-03.s.s3.o.c: Unofanira kutsvaga nhamba dzeven dzimwe dzinogona kuva pa ones place kunze kwe0, 2, 4
y-m-27-03.s.s3.r.c: Pakati pemakadhi 0 kusvika ku4, ari even ndi0, 2, 4 chete.
y-m-27-03.s.s3.o.d: Nhamba dzinoshandisa kadhi rimwe chete kaviri, senge 22 ne44, dzakasanganiswa mu12
y-m-27-03.s.s3.r.d: Kana ukanyora iwe pachako dziya 12 dzakaverengwa nekuwedzera, uchaona nhamba dzisingagoni kugadzirwa.
y-m-27-03.s.s3.explain: Kana ukawedzera nzira 4 dze tens place ne nzira 3 dze ones place, nhamba dzinoshandisa kadhi rimwe chete kaviri, senge 22 ne44, dzinosanganiswa mu12. Kana ukabvisa mbiri idzi, 10 yakarurama. Sezvo huwandu hwemakadhi anogona kushandiswa pa tens place hwakasiyana se4, 3, 3 zvichienderana ne ones place, pane nzira yekuverenga nekuparadzanisa nekadhi re ones place.

y-m-27-04.prereq.0: Ruzivo rwekuverenga huwandu hwenzira kana sarudzo dzakawanda dzichitevedzana
y-m-27-04.title: Kuverenga kwe 'nzira 20' kunosangana nerudzi rwese rwesarudzo here?
y-m-27-04.topic: Huwandu hwenyaya: sarudzo dzinoparadzanisa kurongeka nedzisingaparadzanisi
y-m-27-04.goal: Tsvaga kuti nei kuverenga kumwe chete kuchipa mhedzisiro dzakasiyana kana vanhu vakasarudzwa vane mabasa akasiyana nekana vasina, uye gadzirisa huwandu hwenzira nekuverenga kuti musanganiswa mumwe wakaverengwa nguva dzingani.
y-m-27-04.material:
Kubva pamitezo 5 yekwaya (가온, 나리, 다솜, 라온, 마루), mabasa maviri anofanira kusarudzwa.
(A) Sarudza mutungamiri 1 nesachigaro 1. Munhu mumwe haagoni kubata nzvimbo dzose mbiri.
(B) Sarudza vanhu 2 vekuchenesa stage. Hapana musiyano mubasa rinoitwa nevanhu vaviri vakasarudzwa.
Eunu akagadzirisa mabasa ose maviri se "nzira 5×4=20". Mhinduro yaEunu inoenda seizvi.
y-m-27-04.thinking.2: Kuverenga nekugadzirisa huwandu hwenguva dzakaverengwa kaviri
y-m-27-04.prereq.1: Ruzivo rwekunyora nyaya dzose nekutsiva mazita avanhu nezviratidzo
y-m-27-04.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza mutsara mumwe mumhinduro yaEunu unoomera kuvimba nawo.
y-m-27-04.s.s1.hint.0: Kune (A) ne (B), ronga kuti kuchinjanisa vanhu vaviri vakasarudzwa kunoita musiyano kana kuti zvakafanana.
y-m-27-04.s.s1.hint.1: Pfupisa mazita kuita 가, 나, 다, 라, 마 uye uenzanise kuti (가, 나) ne (나, 가) inyaya imwe chete mu (A) nemu (B) here.
y-m-27-04.s.s1.line.0: Mu (A), vanhu vanogona kuva mutungamiri ndi5.
y-m-27-04.s.s1.line.1: Kana mutungamiri asarudzwa, vanhu vanogona kuva sachigaro ndevamwe 4. Saka (A) ndi nzira 5×4=20.
y-m-27-04.s.s1.line.2: Kune (B) zvakare, pane nzira 5 dzekusarudza munhu wekutanga kutanga, wobva wasarudza wechipiri nenzira 4.
y-m-27-04.s.s1.line.3: Saka (B) zvakare ndi nzira 5×4=20, uye huwandu hwenzira dze (A) ne (B) hwakafanana.
y-m-27-04.s.s1.explain: Mitsara 1 ne2 yakarurama. Mutungamiri nesachigaro mabasa akasiyana, saka (가온 mutungamiri, 나리 sachigaro) ne (나리 mutungamiri, 가온 sachigaro) nyaya dzakasiyana, uye nzira 20 yakarurama. Dambudziko rinotanga pamutsara 3. Mu (B) hapana musiyano mumabasa, saka (가온, 나리) ne (나리, 가온) musanganiswa mumwe chete webasa, asi kana ukaverenga ne5×4 unoverenga zviviri izvi zvakaparadzana uye unoverenga musanganiswa mumwe kaviri. Saka mhedziso yemutsara 4 yekuti '(A) ne (B) zvakafanana' haina kururamawo.
y-m-27-04.s.s2.prompt: Nenzira dzingani zvose unogona kusarudza vanhu 2 vekuchenesa stage mu (B)?
y-m-27-04.s.s2.hint.0: Pfupisa mazita kuita zviratidzo uye unyore masanganiswa nenzira yakarongeka, uchitanga nedziya dzine 가.
y-m-27-04.s.s2.hint.1: Verenga kuti musanganiswa mumwe (semuenzaniso, 가온 ne 나리) wakaverengwa nguva dzingani munzira 20.
y-m-27-04.s.s2.r.a: Uku kukosha kwakaverengwa ne5×4. Tarisa kuti wakaverenga nyaya apo vanhu vaviri vakasarudzwa vakachinjanisirwa zvakaparadzana here.
y-m-27-04.s.s2.r.b: Izvi zvinoita sekukosha kunoverenga nyaya dzekusarudza munhu mumwe chete. Nyora iwe pachako nyaya dzevanhu vaviri vanosarudzwa.
y-m-27-04.s.s2.r.c: Uku kuverenga kunoverenga vanhu vaviri vamwe chete nekurongeka kwakachinjanisirwa sechimwe.
y-m-27-04.s.s2.r.d: Uku kukosha kwakaverenga kunyange kusarudza munhu mumwe chete kaviri. Vanhu 2 vekuchenesa vanofanira kuva vakasiyana.
y-m-27-04.s.s2.explain: 5×4=20 ikukosha kwakaverenga vanhu vaviri vamwe chete nekurongeka kwakachinjanisirwa chete, senge (가온, 나리) ne (나리, 가온), zvakaparadzana. Musanganiswa wega wega webasa wakaverengwa kaviri, saka ndi20÷2=10 nzira. Kana ukazvinyora zvakananga se 가나, 가다, 가라, 가마, 나다, 나라, 나마, 다라, 다마, 라마, zvakare ndi nzira 10.
y-m-27-04.s.s3.prompt: Kana (B) ikashandurwa kuita "vanhu 3 vekuchenesa", nenzira dzingani zvose unogona kusarudza vanhu 3 pa5? (Hapana musiyano mumabasa.)
y-m-27-04.s.s3.hint.0: Nyora nzira dzose dzinogona kurongwa nadzo vanhu vatatu 가, 나, 다 uye uverenge kuti pane nzira dzingani.
y-m-27-04.s.s3.hint.1: Tarisa kuti unowana kukosha kwakafanana kana ukaparadzanisa nyaya nekuti ndiani asina kusarudzwa here.
y-m-27-04.s.s3.r.a: Uku kukosha kwakaverengwa nekuti vanhu vatatu vamwe chete vakaverengwa nguva dzingani. Unowana kukosha kwakafanana kana ukafunga nevanhu vasina kusarudzwa.
y-m-27-04.s.s3.r.b: Uku kukosha kwakamira mushure mekuverenga 5×4×3. Tarisa kuti wakaverenga vanhu vatatu vamwe chete nguva dzakawanda nekurongeka kwakachinjanisirwa chete here.
y-m-27-04.s.s3.r.c: Uku kukosha kwakaparadzanisa ne2 chete sekunge nyaya yevanhu 2. Verenga huwandu hwekurongeka kunogona kuitwa nevanhu vatatu.
y-m-27-04.s.s3.r.d: Uku kukosha kwakashandisa 5×4 sezvayakaita. Maitiro ekusarudza munhu wechitatu aashayikwa.
y-m-27-04.s.s3.explain: 5×4×3=60 ikukosha kunoparadzanisawo kurongeka kwekusarudza vanhu vatatu. Kurongeka kunogona kuitwa nevanhu vatatu vamwe chete ndi 3×2×1=6 nzira, saka musanganiswa wega wega unoverengwa nguva 6. 60÷6=10 nzira. Kusarudza vanhu 3 pa5 kwakafanana nekusarudza vanhu 2 vasina kusarudzwa, saka zvakafananawo nenzira 10 dzekusarudza vanhu 2.

y-m-27-06.title: Dambudziko rema marble apo mhinduro dzinoparadzana kuita mbiri
y-m-27-06.topic: Kuverenga probability: musiyano zvichienderana nekuti chakabviswa chinodzoserwa here kana uchibvisa nenzira inotevedzana
y-m-27-06.goal: Wana kuti mamiriro asipo mudambudziko (kuti marble yakabviswa inodzoserwa here) ndiwo anosarudza mhinduro, enzanisa probability pasi pemamiriro ega ega, uye ronga kuti musiyano pakati pemamiriro maviri unochinja sei kana huwandu hwema marble huchikura.
y-m-27-06.material:
Bhegi rine ma marble tsvuku 3 nema marble bhuruu 2. Ma marble anosiyana neruvara chete uye ane chimiro nehukuru hwakafanana, saka uine maziso akavharwa haugoni kusarudza kuti marble ipi ichabuda. Unobvisa ma marble kubva mubhegi iri rimwe rimwe, kaviri, uye unotarisa mavara.
Dambudziko: "Probability yekuti ma marble maviri akabviswa ane ruvara rumwe chete ndeyei?"
Eunseo akapindura 13/25 uye Doyun akapindura 2/5. Hapana akakanganisa mukuverenga nenzira yake. Asi dambudziko harina kutaura 'kuti marble yakabviswa inodzoserwa mubhegi here'.
y-m-27-06.thinking.1: Kuenzanisa ma probability nekuparadzanisa kuita mamiriro
y-m-27-06.thinking.2: Kufungidzira shanduko kana nhamba dzava hombe

y-m-27-06.prereq.1: Kuverenga ma fraction nekuderedza ma fraction
y-m-27-06.s.s1.hint.0: Nyora kuti Eunseo naDoyun mumwe nemumwe akafungidzira kuti pane ma marble mangani mubhegi pakubvisa kwechipiri.
y-m-27-06.s.s1.hint.1: Tsvaga kuti ma denominator akashandiswa navaviri (5 ne4) anova akasiyana papi.
y-m-27-06.s.s1.o.a: Mhinduro yaEunseo chete ndiyo yakarurama. Kudzosera marble mutemo wekutanga
y-m-27-06.s.s1.r.a: Dambudziko harina mashoko ekudzosera. Funga kuti wakawedzera fungidziro iwe pachako, uchiidaidza mutemo wekutanga here.
y-m-27-06.s.s1.o.b: Mhinduro yaDoyun chete ndiyo yakarurama. Zviri pachena kuti marble yakabviswa inochengetwa kunze
y-m-27-06.s.s1.r.b: Dambudziko harina mashoko ekusadzosera zvakare. Funga kuti wakafungidzira kuti zviri pachena here.
y-m-27-06.s.s1.o.c: Dzose dzakashata. Pane mavara maviri, saka probability yeruvara rumwe chete ndi1/2
y-m-27-06.s.s1.r.c: Ma marble tsvuku akawanda, saka mavara maviri haabudi zvakaenzana. Tarisa huwandu hwema marble, kwete huwandu hwemavara.
y-m-27-06.s.s1.o.d: Haigoni kutarwa pasina kuziva kuti marble yakabviswa inodzoserwa here
y-m-27-06.s.s1.r.d: Wakaona kuti mamiriro asipo ndiwo anosarudza mhinduro. Zvaizonaka kutarisa kuti kukosha kunobuda sei pasi pemamiriro ega ega.
y-m-27-06.s.s1.explain: Kana ukaidzosera, pakubvisa kwechipiri pachine ma marble tsvuku 3 nebhuruu 2, saka (3/5)×(3/5)+(2/5)×(2/5)=13/25, uye kana usingaidzosere, 4 dzinosara pakubvisa kwechipiri, saka (3/5)×(2/4)+(2/5)×(1/4)=2/5. Makosha maviri akasiyana, saka pasina kuziva 'kuti inodzoserwa here' haugoni kusarudza.
y-m-27-06.s.s2.prompt: Mamiriro api anodiwa nemhinduro dzose mbiri kuti dzive dzakarurama?
y-m-27-06.s.s2.hint.0: Enzanisa ma denominator e probability yechipiri mu expression mbiri.
y-m-27-06.s.s2.hint.1: Tarisa kuti ma numerator e probability yechipiri (huwandu hwema marble tsvuku, huwandu hwema marble bhuruu) anoenderana nemhedzisiro yekutanga here.
y-m-27-06.s.s2.r.a: Mumwe nemumwe akatonga nekuti huwandu hwema marble asara pakubvisa marble yechipiri ndi5 kana 4.
y-m-27-06.s.s2.r.b: Tarisa kuti ma marble mangani anosara pakubvisa kwechipiri uchishandisa expression yaEunseo (denominator 5).
y-m-27-06.s.s2.o.c: Vose vaviri vanodzosera uye nzira yekuverenga chete ndiyo yakasiyana
y-m-27-06.s.s2.r.c: Kana ukadzosera, denominator yakafanana 5 pakubvisa marble yechipiri zvakare. Tarisa denominator yaDoyun.
y-m-27-06.s.s2.o.d: Hapana anodzosera uye nzira yekuverenga chete ndiyo yakasiyana
y-m-27-06.s.s2.r.d: Kana usingadzosere, denominator ndi4 pakubvisa marble yechipiri. Tarisa expression yaEunseo.
y-m-27-06.s.s2.explain: Expression yaEunseo (3/5)×(3/5)+(2/5)×(2/5) inobvisa marble yechipiri kubva pa5 zvakare, saka inyaya yekudzosera. Expression yaDoyun (3/5)×(2/4)+(2/5)×(1/4) inobvisa marble yechipiri kubva pa4, saka inyaya yekusadzosera.
y-m-27-06.s.s3.prompt: Kana ukawedzera mabhulu kusvika 30 matsvuku ne 20 bhuruu (reshiyo yakafanana, 3:2) uye ukaenzanisa mamiriro maviri, chii chinoitika kumusiyano pakati pemikana miviri kana tichienzanisa nepakutanga (matsvuku 3, bhuruu 2)?
y-m-27-06.s.s3.hint.0: Nyora muparadzanisi wemukana wokubudisa bhulu rechipiri kana risingadzorerwi, kunyaya yekutanga nenyaya itsva.
y-m-27-06.s.s3.hint.1: Verenga mikana yemamiriro maviri samadhesimali uye uienzanise padivi pomusiyano wekutanga.
y-m-27-06.s.s3.r.a: Enzanisa kuti mabhulu anosara mushure mokubudisa rimwe anoderera zvakadini kana huwandu hwemabhulu hwakawanda.
y-m-27-06.s.s3.r.b: Kunyange reshiyo yakafanana, huwandu hwemabhulu anosara mushure mokubudisa rimwe hwakasiyana. Enzanisa kana vaparadzanisi vari 5 ne 4 nekana vari 50 ne 49.
y-m-27-06.s.s3.r.c: Wakabata poinzi yokuti kana pane mabhulu akawanda, kubudisa rimwe hakuchinji zvakanyanya zvinosara.
y-m-27-06.s.s3.r.d: Ienzanise nechokwadi chokuti kukosha kwekutanga (2/5) kwaiva kudiki kupfuura 13/25. Nyora chirevo uye uverenge kuti utarise.
y-m-27-06.s.s3.explain: Kana ukadzorera, (30/50)²+(20/50)²=13/25=0.52, uye kana usingadzorere, (30/50)(29/49)+(20/50)(19/49)=25/49≈0.510, saka musiyano uri 0.01 kana zvakadaro. Pakutanga, yaiva 13/25=0.52 ne 2/5=0.4, musiyano we 0.12. Mabhulu akawanda, makwandisi emabhulu anosara anochinja zvishoma kunyange mushure mokubudisa rimwe, saka musiyano pakati pemamiriro maviri unova mudiki.

y-m-27-01.title: Kana mukana wemvura waiva 70% uye isina kunaya
y-m-27-01.topic: Zvinoreva probability: mukana wemvura nehukama mudata rakaunganidzwa kakawanda
y-m-27-01.goal: Siyanisa mhedzisiro imwe chete neprobability (mukana), tonga kuti forecast inovimbika zvakadini kubva pahukama mudata rakaunganidzwa pamazuva mazhinji, uye, nguva imwe neimwe data itsva ichibuda, sarudza nezvikonzero kuchengeta kana kugadzirisa kutonga kwako.
y-m-27-01.material:
Forecast yemamiriro ekunze yakati 'mangwana mukana wemvura i 70%', asi mvura haina kunaya zuva rakatevera. Seojin akati, "Forecast yakanga isiri iyo," uye Haeun akati, "70% zvinoreva kuti mvura inonaya pa 70% yemaawa 24 ezuva, anenge maawa 17."
Mubasa iri, 'mukana wemvura we 70%' unotorwa sekureva 'kana pane mazuva mazhinji ane mamiriro eforecast akafanana, mvura inonaya pa anenge 70% eaya', uye zuva apo mvura yakanaya kunyange zvishoma rinoverengwa se 'zuva rakanaya mvura'. Fungawo kuti ma forecast emamiriro ekunze anogona kuva nekukanganisa. (70% inoverengwa se 0.7, kana ka7 pa 10.)
y-m-27-01.thinking.1: Kusiyanisa mhedzisiro imwe chete nehukama pamusoro penguva dzakawanda
y-m-27-01.prereq.0: Kunge wanzwa nezvezvinoreva probability (nhamba inoratidza kuti chinhu chinogona kuitika zvakadini)

Marekodhi emapoka mana (boka: huwandu hwekukanda / huwandu hwenguva poinzi yakatarisa kumusoro)

Boka 2: kukanda 40 / ka18
